summary: Real-ground-truth artifacts, metrics, hashes, and inference reproduce. The selected enhanced model does not improve the reused 2026 holdout; evidence supports implementation claims but not overall, strong-call, or Worlds reliability claims.

audited_snapshot.scope: Trusted-local snapshot; hashes are not external signatures

gt_provenance.details: blue_win is derived from the external dataset team result after composite-key and complementary-result validation; all evaluated CSV labels match games.parquet.

score_normalization.details: Performance metrics use raw labels/probabilities. The validation-margin ECDF is explicitly a non-probability presentation index.

result_existence.details: All 15 prediction CSVs and referenced models/reports exist; rows, IDs, labels, metrics, artifact predictions, and recorded hashes match.

dead_code.details: Metric, temporal split, policy, evaluation, and paired-bootstrap functions are called and their outputs are saved.

scope.details: One seed, one temporal split, reused/previously inspected 2026 holdout, and only 22 target Worlds maps. Current language discloses these limits.

temporal_isolation.details: Strict date and available_at cutoffs, target exclusion, request-time validation, and no target/postgame current-match fields.

source_model_consistency.details: Model, feature, policy, evaluation, runtime, frontend, report, and log hashes match the audited snapshot.

pair_semantics.details: Role-aware champion/player pair observations are historical associations; final explanations use both sides and the minimum pair sample.

no_fabricated_tactical_evidence.details: Reasons/risks come from signed full SHAP groups or explicit evidence gaps; unsupported tactical ratings are absent.

optional_source_failure.details: Judgment failures return unavailable and preserve the standard calibrated result; backend and UI tests cover this path.

verification.bound_browser: 16 passed, 0 failed/skipped/flaky, Chromium and Playwright WebKit
verification.bound_build: strict TypeScript and production build passed
verification.reviewer_frontend_rerun: blocked by local macOS rolldown native-binding code-signature mismatch; source review and bound successful logs used

resolved_during_review: Regenerated an intermediate stale real_analysis pair explanation so the final snapshot uses both sides and the minimum 3-game evidence.
Made the two no-negative-contribution risk fallbacks distinct and explicitly unmodeled/evidence-gap statements.

claims.claim: Enhanced training was attempted and completed on real historical data.
An explicit winner, evidence, and non-probability support index are implemented.
The selected enhanced model improves overall ranking or performance.
The selected enhanced model improves strong-call hit rate.
Strong-group hit rates are descriptive retrospective subgroup statistics.
The system has established Worlds-specific reliability.
